name: Test pack: sci-fi
description: Small content for engine development and automated tests: a workshop and a storage room with a gas leak, in plain names.
help: Two rooms that show every feature of the engine. Search the crate each morning, open the door to the storage room with your cutter, and mind the gas in there: without an air filter it hurts every turn. The workbench repairs, takes apart, makes and modifies; Juno trades and may join you.
